summary: Expanded research covers 73 creative fields through 591 repository queries and 18 model tasks, adding generative gameworld searches. This edition contains 51 full profiles and 5 screened leads, including completed guides for earlier entries and a substantive ComfyUI v0.43 update. Every admitted software license was read in full; weights, paid services and proprietary hosts are separate. All 1,236 entries present at the start of this run already have current weekly reviews; today’s records also receive dated six-check assessments. Quality labels express evidence, not popularity. No discovered app was installed or run. Query failures, bounded pagination and blocked ecosystems remain visible; the findings are broad but not an exhaustive inventory. All 591 repository queries and 18 model-task queries succeeded; 115 repository searches were bounded. Twelve distinct watchlist repository requests returned 404 and one additional commit lookup returned 409, separately from search success. SubGenPlayer now has an unavailable-source assessment; SNAC Go’s current official Forgejo source was recovered and cited without duplicating the tool. Profile breakdown: 42 first additions, 8 completed earlier leads and 1 substantive update; plus 5 new screened leads.
